summary:
AgroRotate AI – NASA-Powered Smart Crop Rotation & Soil Health Advisor

AgroRotate AI is an innovative agricultural decision-support tool designed to help farmers improve soil health, conserve water, and adapt to climate change. The system combines NASA Earth observation data, including SMAP soil moisture, GPM rainfall observations, and MODIS vegetation information, with local soil properties, crop characteristics, and farmer preferences.

It analyzes rainfall patterns, soil moisture, temperature, water availability, and crop nutrient requirements to suggest suitable crop rotation strategies. Farmers can enter their location, soil type, previous crops, and available water resources to receive personalized recommendations.

The platform includes an interactive dashboard, soil health indicators, climate risk analysis, crop rotation suggestions, and water conservation guidance. It also compares different rotation scenarios to help farmers understand their potential benefits.

Our mission is to transform satellite data into practical agricultural insights, support sustainable farming, reduce soil degradation, and build climate-resilient agriculture for a better future.
details: AgroRotate AI – NASA-Powered Smart Crop Rotation & Soil Health Advisor AgroRotate AI is a smart agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers select suitable crop rotation strategies and improve long-term soil health. The platform allows farmers to enter their soil type, water availability, growing season, and previous crop. Based on these inputs, it generates example crop rotation recommendations and provides guidance on water conservation, crop diversity, and soil protection. Our project is designed around NASA Earth observation sources, including SMAP for soil moisture, GPM for rainfall, and MODIS for vegetation monitoring. These datasets are planned for integration to improve climate and agricultural insights. We developed a responsive web prototype using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It includes a farmer-friendly dashboard, farm information inputs, an interactive crop recommendation feature, and NASA data source references. The creative aspect of AgroRotate AI is connecting satellite-based environmental information with practical farming decisions through a simple interface. The intended impact is to support sustainable agriculture, reduce soil degradation, encourage efficient water use, and help farmers explore climate-resilient farming strategies. Our vision is to make advanced Earth observation technology more accessible and useful for farmers around the world.
